title: Countdown Bar
subtitle: Timed bars run independently of the playlist and keep evaluating from the Player's cached manifest.
loadError: Countdown bars could not be loaded.
emptyDescription: Create an instance to show a locally-timed bar on selected screens.
deleteBody: The bar will be removed from targeted Players.

editor.subtitle: The Player evaluates this schedule locally. Priority decides which bar wins when instances overlap.
editor.completionHint: Shown for one minute after the target; leave blank to hide at zero.
editor.confettiLabel: Show confetti when the countdown reaches zero
editor.oneTimeHint: Entered in this browser's local time; the Player counts down to the same instant.
editor.progressHint: Drain empties the bar from right to left as the target approaches.
editor.paddingHint: Lower padding gives the message and countdown more room.
editor.textScaleHint: Increase the type size without changing the bar height.
editor.urgencyDescription: Change the bar automatically as the target approaches. Untouched stage times follow the total lead time; custom values stay fixed. Completed messages return to the normal size.
editor.pulseHint: The bar and text grow by 25% during this final stage.

validation.timezone: Enter an IANA timezone such as America/Chicago.
validation.wholeMinutes: Enter a whole number of minutes.
validation.leadRange: Lead time must be between 1 and 43200 minutes.
validation.heightRange: Enter a height between 40 and 320 pixels.
validation.textScaleRange: Enter a text size between 25 and 500 percent.
validation.soonRange: Starting soon must begin between 1 and 1440 minutes before zero.
validation.wholeSeconds: Enter a whole number of seconds.
validation.urgentRange: Urgent must begin between 2 and 3600 seconds before zero.
validation.pulseRange: Pulse must begin between 1 and 60 seconds before zero.
validation.weeklyRequired: Choose a target time and at least one day.
validation.oneTimeRequired: Choose the one-time target date and time.
validation.stageOrder: Stages must begin in order: starting soon, urgent, then pulse.
